events.headline: Klarna revenue and adjusted earnings beat estimates despite wider-than-expected loss

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Klarna showed resilience following its November 17 earnings report, shrugging off a wider loss to trade higher on revenue beats and a focus on high-margin 'Fair Financing.' The strategic pivot toward increasing average revenue per user and accelerating 30% US transaction volume growth suggests the business is successfully scaling past its post-IPO repricing phase.
providers.risk: Macroeconomic headwinds in Germany, its largest market, and sensitive credit quality metrics could lead to volatile earnings performance.

providers.reason: Q3 revenue rose 12% to $1.009B, beating guidance on every line; GMV grew 10%, US momentum accelerated, credit provisions improved and adjusted operating income turned positive. Shares rose 4.7% and Freedom Capital lifted its target to $20, supporting short-term post-earnings drift.
providers.risk: EU consumer-credit rules take effect November 20, just inside the horizon, potentially pressuring BNPL approval rates and holiday demand; Klarna also remains unprofitable.
